h1: Outrise 首页需求与英文文案（2026-10 版）

callout.p: 状态：当前首页内容与视觉探索依据。先比较三张视觉概念稿；确认方向后制作完整响应式 HTML。文末“历史参考”保留旧材料、图片与评论，不能作为当前官网事实。

p: 对外定位：Outrise 是专注北美市场的 AI-native 营销团队，以外部 CMO 与营销团队的角色，帮助客户判断方向、选择渠道、制定规划，并推进约定范围内的关键执行。
首页目标：让访客迅速理解 Outrise 服务谁、如何把营销判断与渠道行动连接起来、AI-native 具体体现在哪里、由谁统筹交付，以及如何开始沟通。首页默认英文；本文件的需求说明为中文。
已确认来源：2026 年 10 月新版 16 页 Outrise 公司介绍及“整理 Outrise 公司介绍大纲”中的直接需求。公司介绍源文件位于仓库 docs/presentations/outrise-company-introduction/。Crowdcore 仅作深浅分区、媒体节奏与页面留白参考，不沿用其品牌、素材、数字或布局细节。
首版范围：单页展示型官网，真实邮箱联系入口；不设置表单、CRM、数据库、独立子页或正式域名发布。本阶段先交付需求与三张视觉稿；完整 HTML 在视觉方向确定后制作。

td.p: 面向北美市场的消费品牌，包含正在进入市场或希望进一步增长的品牌。
同时考虑品牌认知与电商销售；连接受众、品牌表达、内容、达人与渠道选择。
在北美开展 go-to-market 的科技创业公司，不限于 Consumer Tech 或 2C 类别。
解释产品价值、确定市场表达与 GTM 优先级，选择合适传播及营销渠道。

p: 内部范围说明：科技客户不再按旧版的 Consumer Tech、AI 服务和 SaaS 窄分类限定。具体项目仍按营销目标与团队能力判断；首页不承诺传统 B2B 线索获取、产品内激活与留存系统、产品改造或完整 PLG。
服务深度：Outrise 提供判断、规划、统筹和关键执行。日常运营量、投放管理范围、达人数量、交付频率、合作期限和费用在具体合作方案中约定；首页不作无限范围承诺。
h2: 3. 业务体系：两项核心能力并列
p:
Marketing Strategy & Brand Foundations ＋ Channel Operations & Growth
↓
Content Marketing / Influencer Marketing / Paid Media
↓
按需协作的本地渠道、落地执行、PR 等专业伙伴

td.p: 并列核心 1
理解市场与受众，明确定位、价值表达、GTM 目标和营销优先级。
并列核心 2
规划渠道组合、运营路径与资源投入，统筹关键工作，复盘并调整。
直接执行

p.b: Content Marketing / Influencer Marketing / Paid Media

td.p: 三类手段根据目标组合，内容表达、创作者合作和投放均与上层判断衔接。
专业协作
本地渠道拓展、落地执行、PR 等按需引入，由 Outrise 统一组织与协调，并在项目中明确范围。

p: GEO / SEO：仅在具体需求与提案中选择性说明专业合作团队的参与，不进入首页主服务区、导航或自营核心承诺。
八个连续问题：你是谁 → 是否适合我 → 能提供什么 → 为什么选你 → 怎样推进 → 有什么经验 → 谁来负责 → 怎样开始。
导航：OUTRISE 文字标识 / Who We Help / Capabilities / How We Work / Experience / Let’s talk。前四个为页内锚点；Let’s talk 使用 mailto:hello@outrisetech.com。移动端菜单展开后显示相同去向并能键盘关闭。
页面结构：Hero → Who We Help → What We Do → Why Outrise → How We Work → Selected Experience → Working Together（含精简 FAQ）→ Closing / Footer。
h2: 5. 逐区块需求与完整英文文案
h3: 5.1 Hero — 先说明身份与市场
p: 区块目标：首屏同时呈现北美市场、外部 CMO 与团队角色、AI-native 工作方式及两类客户。主操作直接到真实邮箱，次操作跳转服务区。
Eyebrow：AI-NATIVE. NORTH AMERICA FOCUSED.
H1：Your CMO and marketing team for North America.
Body：Outrise works as your external CMO and marketing team. We help consumer brands and tech startups define their position, choose the right channels, and turn plans into focused marketing action.
Primary action：Let’s talk → mailto:hello@outrisetech.com
Secondary action：Explore our approach → #capabilities
视觉要求：文字可在 1440px 第一视窗内独立成立；媒体表达市场与渠道关系，不用虚构仪表盘或客户标识。手机首屏保持标题、简述和主操作清晰可见。
h3: 5.2 Who We Help — 让客户判断适配
p: Section label：WHO WE HELP
H2：Build your brand. Bring your product to market.
Intro：Two kinds of teams, one shared need: clearer decisions about how to grow in North America.
Audience 1 label：CONSUMER BRANDS
Audience 1 heading：Build recognition and ecommerce momentum.
Audience 1 body：We help consumer brands understand the audience, sharpen their story, and connect content, creators, channels, and commerce around the next stage of growth.
Audience 1 focus：Brand positioning / content and creator direction / ecommerce channel priorities
Audience 2 label：TECH STARTUPS
Audience 2 heading：Make a new product make sense in market.
Audience 2 body：We help tech startups explain their value, set go-to-market priorities, and choose the marketing channels that help the right people discover and understand the product.
Audience 2 focus：Value proposition / GTM priorities / channel and launch planning
布局要求：两类客户等权并列；移动端按同一顺序单列。范围说明留在内部，不把不服务项目写成首页负面清单。
h3: 5.3 What We Do — 两个核心连接三类执行
p: Section label：CAPABILITIES
H2：Clear direction. Connected execution.
Intro：We pair strategic judgment with channel planning, then activate the mix of content, creators, and paid media the work calls for.
Core capability 1：Marketing Strategy & Brand Foundations
Core capability 1 body：Understand the market and audience. Define the position, value story, go-to-market priorities, and decisions that should guide the work.
Core capability 2：Channel Operations & Growth
Core capability 2 body：Choose the channel mix, plan programs and resources, coordinate priority work, and review what the market is telling us.
Execution 1：Content Marketing — Turn the strategy into messages, creative directions, and content people can use to understand the brand or product.
Execution 2：Influencer Marketing — Match creators and collaboration formats to the audience, story, and role each campaign needs to play.
Execution 3：Paid Media — Plan and manage agreed paid activity in support of the wider channel and growth priorities.
Partner note：When the plan calls for local channel access, on-the-ground work, or PR, we bring in specialist partners and coordinate their contribution.
布局要求：两个核心容器面积与标题权重相同；三项执行位于下一层，伙伴说明作为单独轻量注释。不做五张同权服务卡，也不暗示固定套餐。
h3: 5.4 Why Outrise — 把 AI-native 与市场理解分开讲
p: Section label：WHY OUTRISE
H2：AI-native in how we work. Market-aware in what we do.
Intro：Our way of working connects faster research and production with the judgment needed to make useful marketing decisions.
Column 1 heading：An AI-native working system

Column 1 body：Our established AI-driven workflow supports research and knowledge, planning and tasks, content and creative development, and feedback and learning. The team remains responsible for direction, decisions, and quality.
Column 2 heading：A changing market in view
Column 2 body：AI is changing how people discover, evaluate, and talk about products. We account for those shifts when shaping the message, choosing channels, and deciding what to test next.
视觉要求：可用信息关系和真实营销媒介展示工作流；不使用工具 Logo 墙、聊天机器人、未经验证的后台界面、自动化比例或虚构专有模型。
h3: 5.5 How We Work — 让判断、计划与交付可见
p: Section label：HOW WE WORK
H2：From business questions to the next clear move.
Intro：We start with the business context, make the marketing choices explicit, and keep priority work moving as new signals appear.
Stage 1：01 / Understand & decide — We learn the product, audience, goals, constraints, and North American market context. Then we identify the decisions that matter most.
Stage 1 output：Typical outputs: market and audience judgment; priority questions.
Stage 2：02 / Choose & plan — We define the story, channel roles, sequence of work, and resources needed for the next stage.
Stage 2 output：Typical outputs: marketing roadmap; channel priorities; program plan.
Stage 3：03 / Execute & adjust — We move agreed priority work forward, coordinate specialists where needed, review signals, and update the plan.
Stage 3 output：Typical outputs: content or creator briefs; paid activity plan; progress review and next actions.
Footnote：Outputs vary by engagement and are shown here as illustrative examples, not a fixed deliverables package.
布局要求：三阶段有明确时序，但可以按项目循环；输出示例需与对应判断或行动绑定，不能包装为某个真实客户成果。
h3: 5.6 Selected Experience — 匿名项目只展示真实工作范围
p: Section label：SELECTED EXPERIENCE
H2：Connecting brand, content, and channels.
Case label：CONSUMER BAG BRAND / NORTH AMERICA
Case intro：For a consumer bag brand working toward North American growth, the marketing challenge was to connect the product story with the channels where people discover, compare, and buy.
Work heading：What the work covered
Work body：Product and storefront improvements, creator screening and outreach, Amazon ad adjustments, and coordinated planning across TikTok, Amazon, and the brand website.
Connection line：Each workstream served the same market story and channel priorities rather than operating as a separate tactic.
Case note：Client identity and commercial outcomes are withheld. This example describes work scope and coordination, not a performance claim.
素材要求：未经客户授权不展示品牌名、Logo、店铺截图、投放画面、增长率、ROAS 或客户引语。若用概念影像必须标明其为概念视觉。
h3: 5.7 Working Together — 说明合作方式与责任
p: Section label：WORKING TOGETHER
H2：One point of contact. One accountable team.

Body：Outrise takes responsibility for the agreed strategy, plan, progress, quality, and specialist coordination. Your team brings product truth, business context, resources, and timely decisions. We define the execution scope together before work begins.
Mode 1：Strategy Consulting — Senior judgment and a clear set of priorities for a specific marketing question.
Mode 2：Stage-based Project — A focused GTM, brand, or channel program with defined outcomes and workstreams.
Mode 3：Ongoing External CMO & Team — Continued strategic leadership and coordinated marketing progress within an agreed scope.
Responsibility note：We stand behind the agreed work and coordination. Commercial results depend on the product, market, investment, and decisions beyond any one marketing team.
FAQ Q1：Who is Outrise best suited to?
FAQ A1：Consumer brands building recognition and ecommerce growth in North America, and tech startups that need clearer go-to-market choices and marketing execution.
FAQ Q2：Can you work with our existing team or agency?
FAQ A2：Yes. We can lead a defined marketing program, support an internal team, or coordinate specialist partners around an agreed plan.
FAQ Q3：How much execution is included?
FAQ A3：It depends on the engagement. We define the workstreams, responsibilities, and operating rhythm together before delivery begins.
FAQ Q4：What does AI-native mean here?
FAQ A4：AI supports how we research, plan, develop content, and learn from feedback. People remain accountable for the strategy, choices, relationships, and quality of the work.
交互要求：FAQ 使用原生或等效可访问展开控件；合作模式不展示固定套餐价格和未经确认的服务时限。
h3: 5.8 Closing & Footer — 给出真实下一步
p: Section label：LET’S START
H2：What’s next for your business in North America?
Body：Tell us about your product, your North American goals, and the marketing question you are working through.
CTA：Email Outrise → mailto:hello@outrisetech.com
Footer：OUTRISE / Who We Help / Capabilities / How We Work / Experience / hello@outrisetech.com / Back to top。首版不收集访客信息。
h2: 6. 视觉原型、素材与设计规则
p: 共同基底：公司介绍的石墨黑、米白、细线、简洁文字标识；参考 Crowdcore 的大留白、媒体节奏和明暗区分。参考用于启发，不复制画面或品牌资产。

ol.li: 编辑式品牌顾问：米白为主，大标题和细线分区，少量深色段落与真实感概念媒体。优先检验外部 CMO 的专业感与信息清晰度。
AI-native 工作现场：深石墨主背景，研究、产品、内容和创作者媒介以克制方式组合。优先检验 AI 工作方式与执行能力的具体感。
策略与市场连接：明暗交替，将市场信息、双核心判断、三类渠道行动组织为可读关系。优先检验北美聚焦和协同能力。

p: 视觉稿范围：每张按 1440px 宽纵向网页构图，覆盖 Hero、Who We Help、Capabilities。三个方向保持相同事实和核心文案，构图、明暗、媒体关系明显不同；附中文延展说明。选定方向后再扩展全部八区块及移动版。
资产边界：没有正式 Logo 时使用 OUTRISE 文字版；概念影像不得冒充客户素材或产品界面。素材来自已授权文件、自制内容或生成图，并记录来源。避免虚构数字、引语、客户 Logo 和 AI 产能数据。
设计规则：字体不超过两种；正文与按钮对比清晰。动效只服务阅读顺序或信息关系；移动端与 prefers-reduced-motion 模式采用静态状态。
h2: 7. HTML 阶段交互、响应式与技术边界
p: 实现：在当前 Outrise 仓库中用 React + Vite + TypeScript 制作独立英文首页。首页文案与展示数据集中维护，方便后续增加真实案例与内容。

td.p: 完整桌面构图，清晰导航、双列客户区、双核心能力与三执行层级。
768px
根据内容宽度切为单列或紧凑双列；媒体不遮挡文案。
390px
单列叙事、可触控菜单、静态媒体、完整 CTA 与 FAQ。
320px
不横向溢出；标题、长词和按钮安全换行。

ul.li: 页内锚点、手机菜单、FAQ 和真实邮箱链接可用；支持键盘导航与明显焦点状态。
图片按信息价值提供准确 alt；纯装饰元素不传达唯一内容。
尊重 prefers-reduced-motion；无强制自动轮播或影响阅读的连续动画。
不新增后端、业务 API、表单、数据库、CRM、子页面或正式上线流程。

h2: 8. 事实、旧内容处理与验收
p: 保留：旧文档尾部的图片、评论、旧版结构与历史规划留在“历史参考”区。新公司介绍的匿名箱包品牌工作范围可以作为经验区内容，但不作为公开业绩证明。
停用：旧版“策略统领 Ops / Content / Influencer”、Consumer Tech 窄客户定义、无联系入口、5.4x、402%、500+、$5,851、品牌 Logo 墙、AI 产能与未核实增长承诺，均不进入当前首页。旧版子页规划仅供历史追溯。
已确认：北美市场、两类客户、双核心能力、三类直接执行、专业伙伴协作、已建立的 AI-driven 工作体系、匿名箱包项目范围，以及 hello@outrisetech.com。具体合作范围以项目约定为准。
待后续确认：正式品牌资产、客户案例公开授权、可披露结果、真实团队资料与任何服务定价；首版不依赖这些内容上线。
checkbox: 首屏清楚表达北美市场、AI-native、外部 CMO 与团队、消费品牌与科技创业公司。
两项核心能力等权展示；内容、达人、投放与专业伙伴处在正确层级。
三张视觉稿采用相同事实与核心文案，布局和阅读体验确实不同。
AI-native、匿名经验和整体责任表述准确，不制造软件界面、数字或结果。
方向选定后的 HTML 在 320、390、768、1440px 无溢出；导航、邮箱、FAQ、键盘和减少动态效果可用。
相关文档、视觉稿与最终代码通过适当检查后提交指定仓库，推送成功并验证远端同步。

ol.li: 需求文案：修订本文档并同步飞书原文，保留历史内容。
视觉探索：交付三张独立概念稿，用户选定或提出组合与调整意见。
完整原型：以已选视觉稿为目标扩展八个 section，制作桌面与手机响应式 HTML，并完成浏览器验收。
版本同步：检查变更后提交并推送文档、设计资料与代码，核对远端状态。
